snippet.title: Tecmo's Deception: Invitation to Darkness (PS1) Trailer
snippet.description: Deception (Tecmo) was released for the Playstation in 1996.  It's one of the only games that allows you to control the terror.  You know how in most horror games, you wander around a haunted mansion trying to avoid dangers and traps.  In Deception, you are the one setting the traps and creating the dangers for visitors to the Castle of the Damned, visitors both good and evil alike.  There's a lot of Satanic reference in the game so it's not for everyone.
